description: CAST and the :: operator across the scalar families: to VARCHAR/INTEGER/FLOAT/DOUBLE/BOOLEAN/NUMBER, NULL propagation, casts in WHERE, concatenation and CASE, chained casts, multiple casts per select - and the HALF_AWAY_FROM_ZERO rounding an integer cast applies (2.5 -> 3, -2.5 -> -3, never truncation), with bare NUMBER meaning NUMBER(38,0) so '123.45' rounds to 123; an unparseable string is a runtime cast error. Converted 1:1 from expressions/CastExpressionsTest (now retired).
